# Evaluation in Production {#sec-production-eval}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- build the ladder from offline eval to A/B test and know what each stage catches;
- gate a merge on an eval suite the way you gate on unit tests;
- detect drift at the prompt, model, and use-case level;
- curate a golden set from real traffic without leaking user data.

## Exercises

1. Add an eval gate to a repository. Submit a deliberately worse prompt and confirm CI blocks it.
2. Sample 100 production sessions and score them. What did you learn that offline evaluation could not have told you?
